record.paper_title: Open Problems on Ultrafilters and Some Connections to the Continuum
record.context_brief: Uniqueness of cuts in cut spectra
record.original_question: For a regular ultrafilter D on I with λ = |I|, say that D has uniqueness for a regular cardinal κ when any two cuts in C(D) with left cofinality κ have the same right cofinality: if (κ,θ) and (κ,θ') both belong to C(D), then θ = θ'. What are necessary and sufficient conditions on D ensuring that D has uniqueness for every regular κ ≤ λ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $I$ be an infinite set of cardinality $\lambda$, and let $D$ be a regular ultrafilter on $I$ (i.e., $D$ contains a family $\{X_i : i \in I\}$ such that every $\alpha \in I$ belongs to only finitely many $X_i$). Consider the linear order $(\mathbb{N}, <)^I / D$. A pair $(\kappa, \theta)$ of regular cardinals is said to belong to the cut spectrum $\mathcal{C}(D)$ if there exist sequences $(a_\alpha)_{\alpha < \kappa}$ and $(b_\beta)_{\beta < \theta}$ in $(\mathbb{N}, <)^I / D$ such that:
\begin{itemize}
\item $a_\alpha < a_{\alpha'}$ for $\alpha < \alpha' < \kappa$,
\item $b_\beta > b_{\beta'}$ for $\beta < \beta' < \theta$,
\item $a_\alpha < b_\beta$ for all $\alpha < \kappa$ and $\beta < \theta$,
\item there is no $c$ with $a_\alpha < c < b_\beta$ for all $\alpha, \beta$ (i.e., the pre-cut is unfilled).
\end{itemize}
Say that $D$ has uniqueness for the regular cardinal $\kappa$ if whenever $(\kappa, \theta)$ and $(\kappa, \theta')$ both belong to $\mathcal{C}(D)$, then $\theta = \theta'$.

Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on a regular ultrafilter $D$ on $I$ for $D$ to have uniqueness for every regular cardinal $\kappa \le \lambda$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in the Malliaris–Shelah line of work on cofinality spectra and cut spectra of regular ultrafilters. While there are partial results characterizing which pairs $(\kappa,\theta)$ can appear in $\mathcal{C}(D)$ (e.g., symmetric cuts, peculiar cuts, lower cofinality conditions), a complete necessary-and-sufficient characterization of uniqueness for all regular $\kappa \le \lambda$ does not appear to have been established in the available literature, and the problem is posed as open in surveys on ultrafilter problems.

status_evidence.title: Cofinality spectrum theorems in model theory, set theory and general topology
status_evidence.snippet: Develops the theory of cuts in C(D) including symmetric cuts and peculiar cuts; obtains partial structural results on which (kappa,theta) belong to the cut spectrum.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial results on the cut spectrum without establishing a complete characterization of uniqueness.

status_evidence.title: On ultrafilter construction (2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work by Malliaris on constructing regular ultrafilters with prescribed cut spectra properties; does not announce a characterization of uniqueness for all regular kappa.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature continues to study the cut spectrum without resolving the uniqueness characterization.
